name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LeafView.encryptorSetup_close
title: The WE encryptor's own (B, W, T) is close to Def_SuccinctLWE's
statement: For Def_SuccinctLWE parameters p with q prime, m = mb + l n k (mb > 0), sigma >= 1, 2 sigma <= q, 3 m exp(-pi sigma^2) <= 1/2 and sigma sqrt(M') + lnk <= sigma M' (M' = lm + m): the encryptor's law encLaw (B uniform, W = [A | H - A R] with A uniform and R uniform binary, T by flooding with the short preimage map of W) is within lnk (2 theta + 6 M' 4^{-M'} + 3 2^{M'} 4^{-M'^2}) + 4(l+1)(12 m exp(-pi sigma^2) + (q^n + q^{ln})(4/sigma)^m) + 2 lnk sqrt(q^{ln}/2^{mb})/2 of chalLaw (B, W uniform, T <- trapdoorLaw p B W), theta = pi M'(b^2 + 2 sigma M' b)/sigma^2, b = lnk.
